title: Mumbai on ‘orange’ alert as IMD warns of heavy rain in parts of Maharashtra
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — INDIA
key_facts: IMD issued a weather alert for Mumbai, reports suggest.
Heavy rain is expected over the next few hours, officials said.
